about_the_game:
Sticky Date is an anti-dating simulator that subverts the genre and provides catharsis through relatable, raw and satirical dates.

You play as an underpaid dumpling cook who, in order to make ends meet, gets recruited by a sketchy dating app agent. This dating app company uses powerful technology (and maybe just a bit of magic) to make sure that their users will never find true love and keep on using the app.

The player chooses dialogue options for both of the characters going on a date: the goal is to make the date go as bad as possible, the choices varying between complete disaster and placid romance. 

Can the cook make enough money to survive? Will the date-crashing have unforeseen consequences? Stick around to find out.

content_descriptors.notes: We are depicting adults in dating situations, so there will be depictions of some crude humor and sexual themes/innuendos. The dates are also happening in a bar environment so there will be occasional alcohol/tobacco use. The game will also tackle topics such as mental illness, poverty and substance abuse.
